name: How long does it take to install an adjustable showerhead?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to install an adjustable showerhead?

acceptedAnswer.text: A straightforward replacement of an existing showerhead with a new adjustable model typically takes 15 to 30 minutes for an experienced individual or professional. This involves unscrewing the old unit, cleaning the threads, applying plumber's tape, and screwing on the new one. If the installation requires modifying the shower arm, repairing pipes, or dealing with unforeseen issues, the process can take an hour or more, depending on the complexity of the plumbing work involved.
acceptedAnswer.description: Simple replacements usually take 15-30 minutes; complex installations with plumbing modifications can take an hour or more.
